label: Computer Use 是什么

label: 为什么需要 Computer Use
action: 比较完成退货的两种入口
actionEn: Compare two routes to completing a return
look: 同一退货目标分成 API 和界面两条路线，两边都以完成记录为终点。
The return goal branches into an API route and an interface route. Both end with a completed record.
say: 客户要给 1048 号订单退货。AI 告诉我们点哪里，还不算办完，应用里得出现退货记录。软件如果提供 API，也就是给程序调用的接口，可以直接请求创建退货；需要在屏幕上处理时，再观察和操作界面。实际工作可以把两条路接起来。

The customer wants to return order 1048. Instructions about where to click are not enough; the app needs an actual return record. An API provides a direct interface for programs, so an available API can create the return directly. When work requires the screen, the system observes and operates the interface. A workflow can combine both routes.

label: Computer Use 如何工作
action: 连续播放截图、定位、填表和验证
actionEn: Play observation, targeting, form entry and verification
look: 新截图已确认 R-204 回执；左边的应用结果与右边的 context 对上了。
A fresh screenshot confirms receipt R-204. The app result matches the context on the right.
say: 截图进入 context，也就是模型这次判断能用的目标、画面和操作记录。把“订单号输入框”对应到画面上的位置，叫 UI grounding。模型再发出 tool call，请工具点击和键入。动作改变界面，新的观察又影响下一步。最后提交成功，新截图带回回执，这才拿到完成证据。Agent 把目标、观察、工具和反馈串成这样一个循环。

First, the screenshot joins the context: the goal, screen and action history available for this decision. UI grounding connects “the order-number field” to a position on screen. A tool call asks a tool to click or type. Actions change the app, and fresh observations inform the next step. Finally, submission produces a receipt, and a new screenshot supplies evidence of completion. The agent connects goals, observations, tools and feedback in this loop.

label: Computer Use 如何处理意外

Now a popup covers the form, but context still contains the old screenshot. The model requested a click from that old view, and the tool executed it. It hit the overlay, so no return was created. Checking only whether the mouse clicked would give the wrong impression. Pause here: should it click again, or take another look?

label: Computer Use 如何训练
action: 播放多任务练习、反馈与参数更新
actionEn: Play varied practice, feedback and weight updates
look: 多种练习的反馈已汇入训练，weights 从 v1 更新为 v2；尚未进入新界面的使用阶段。
Feedback from varied tasks has entered training. Weights have changed from v1 to v2; the new interface has not appeared yet.
say: 训练会让模型练习许多任务：找按钮、填写信息、完成流程，再用结果提供反馈。训练程序根据这些反馈，反复调整 weights，也就是模型内部学到的参数。这样改变的是以后处理新任务的能力。以 OpenAI 的 CUA 为例，公开介绍包含强化学习，让模型通过尝试和反馈学习操作。这里把许多轮练习缩成了一段示意。

Training gives the model many tasks: finding controls, entering information and completing workflows. Their outcomes provide feedback, which the training process uses to adjust weights, the model’s learned parameters. These changes affect future tasks. OpenAI’s CUA, for example, uses reinforcement learning to learn through attempts and feedback. This illustration condenses many practice rounds.

Now move the button. The model reads a fresh screenshot, updates context and locates the target again. Its learned weights stay fixed. Once you’ve learned to drive, a new junction may change your route without requiring another driving course. Training establishes capability; use applies that capability to current information. Decoding selects the next token and appends it to what is already there. A token can be a word, character or piece of text. label: Jev 与普通 LLM 的输出方式
labelEn: How Jev differs from an LLM
action: 连续展示 LLM 和 Jev，停在并排结果
actionEn: Show both routes, ending with results side by side
look: 左边保留 LLM 的 JSON，右边保留共享 state 上的多个类型化判断。
The LLM’s JSON remains on the left, beside several typed decisions over shared state on the right.
say: 左边给普通 LLM 加上 JSON Schema，也就是规定字段、类型和允许的值。它完全可以一次返回合法 JSON、回答多个问题。约束 decoding 会限制哪些 token 可以出现，但答案仍然逐段生成；这里展示的是可读片段，不是它真实的 token 切分。右边的 Jev 收窄了输出能力：不续写自由文本，而是回答预先定义的问题。多个问题共用 state，独立判断并可并行处理。Choice 做分类，Score 按标准评分，Noul 返回一个陈述的概率。两边都能把结果交给代码；差别在模型面向什么来训练和输出。这里不做速度比较。

On the left, an ordinary LLM uses JSON Schema to specify fields, types and allowed values. It can return valid JSON and answer several questions in one call. Constrained decoding limits which tokens may appear, while the response is still generated sequentially. These are readable display fragments, not an actual tokenizer trace. Jev narrows its output capability: it answers predefined questions instead of continuing free-form text. Questions share state, are evaluated independently and can run in parallel. Choice classifies, Score uses a scoring standard, and Noul returns a proposition’s probability. Both routes give results to code; their training and output design differ. This animation is not a speed comparison.

say: 左边给普通 LLM 加上 JSON Schema，也就是规定字段、类型和允许的值。它完全可以一次返回合法 JSON、回答多个问题。约束 decoding 会限制哪些 token 可以出现，但答案仍然逐段生成；这里展示的是可读片段，不是它真实的 token 切分。

On the left, an ordinary LLM uses JSON Schema to specify fields, types and allowed values. It can return valid JSON and answer several questions in one call. Constrained decoding limits which tokens may appear, while the response is still generated sequentially. These are readable display fragments, not an actual tokenizer trace.

label: Jev 返回预定义判断
Jev returns typed decisions
end: 两条输出路径并排对照
Both output paths remain side by side
say: 右边的 Jev 收窄了输出能力：不续写自由文本，而是回答预先定义的问题。多个问题共用 state，独立判断并可并行处理。Choice 做分类，Score 按标准评分，Noul 返回一个陈述的概率。两边都能把结果交给代码；差别在模型面向什么来训练和输出。这里不做速度比较。

Jev narrows its output capability: it answers predefined questions instead of continuing free-form text. Questions share state, are evaluated independently and can run in parallel. Choice classifies, Score uses a scoring standard, and Noul returns a proposition’s probability. Both routes give results to code; their training and output design differ. This animation is not a speed comparison.

label: Jev 如何训练
action: 保留同一封邮件，依次显示作答、对答案和训练后的变化
actionEn: Keep one email visible through prediction, feedback and the illustrative update
look: 左边的邮件不变；中间的预测与右边已知答案对照，再显示多例训练后的变化。
The email stays on the left; the prediction is compared with the known answer, then changes after illustrative training across many examples.
say: 先看这一封：钱扣了两次，但鞋子要留下。模型却选了退货，给出 0.95；对照右边的已知答案，应该交给账单部门。训练时，我们可以把这种差异作为反馈：不只看选对没有，还要看它给出的概率。一次错例说明这次需要反馈，不能单凭它评价整个模型的校准程度。现在让许多带答案的例子一起提供反馈，反复更新 weights，也就是模型内部影响判断的参数。再看同一封邮件，预测条从退货移向账单，这样就能看见训练改变了什么。TypeSafe 把面向决策和校准概率的后训练称为 RLCD。画面里的 v1、v2 和数值只是示意，不代表看过这一封就必定这样变化；公开资料也没有披露具体更新算法。学会旧题还不够，接下来换新题。

Start with one email: the customer was charged twice but is keeping the shoes. The model picks returns with probability 0.95; the known answer on the right is billing. During training, this mismatch can provide feedback on both the decision and its probability. One mistake provides feedback for this example; it does not establish the model’s overall calibration. Now many labeled examples provide feedback for repeated updates to weights, the internal parameters that shape predictions. Revisit the same email: the bars move from returns toward billing, making the illustrated change visible. TypeSafe calls its post-training for decisions and calibrated probabilities RLCD. The versions and numbers are illustrative, not a guaranteed change after seeing one email; the detailed update algorithm is not disclosed here. Doing better on an old case is not enough, so test new ones next.

label: 作答，再对答案
Predict, then check the answer
end: 预测 returns 0.95，已知答案是 billing
Prediction: returns at 0.95; known answer: billing
say: 先看这一封：钱扣了两次，但鞋子要留下。模型却选了退货，给出 0.95；对照右边的已知答案，应该交给账单部门。训练时，我们可以把这种差异作为反馈：不只看选对没有，还要看它给出的概率。一次错例说明这次需要反馈，不能单凭它评价整个模型的校准程度。

label: 多例反馈更新模型，再看同一封邮件
Update from many examples, then revisit the same email
end: 同一封邮件的预测从 returns 变为 billing
The same email now receives billing instead of returns
say: 现在让许多带答案的例子一起提供反馈，反复更新 weights，也就是模型内部影响判断的参数。再看同一封邮件，预测条从退货移向账单，这样就能看见训练改变了什么。TypeSafe 把面向决策和校准概率的后训练称为 RLCD。画面里的 v1、v2 和数值只是示意，不代表看过这一封就必定这样变化；公开资料也没有披露具体更新算法。学会旧题还不够，接下来换新题。

The versions and numbers are illustrative, not a guaranteed change after seeing one email; the detailed update algorithm is not disclosed here. label: 用独立新题检查 Calibration
action: 先看新邮件的预测，再揭晓答案与整组校准示意
actionEn: Inspect a new email, then reveal its answer and the calibration illustration
look: 新邮件换了措辞，v2 的 weights 固定；先预测 billing 0.80，再对答案和整组频率。
The new email uses different wording and v2 has fixed weights; predict billing at 0.80, then check its answer and the group frequency.
say: 这次换成订单 2062：付款被处理了两遍。它没参与刚才的训练，措辞也不同。现在 weights 固定，只让模型作答。它给账单部门约 0.80 的概率。先把答案藏起来，是为了区分“靠训练记住旧题”和“面对新材料作判断”。这封的答案确实是账单，但一封答对还不够。Calibration，校准，要看很多次：模型报出约八成概率的那些判断，长期是否也约八成正确。下面用十个结果里的八对两错帮助理解。这不是 Jev 的实测成绩，也不保证每十次都恰好八对。训练目标是一回事，换到自己的任务上是否做到了，还得这样检验。

This time, payment for order 2062 went through twice. This differently worded email did not contribute to training. Keep the weights fixed and ask for a prediction: billing at about 0.80. Hiding the answer distinguishes revisiting a training example from making a decision on new material. The correct answer is billing, but one correct prediction is not enough. Calibration requires many cases: among predictions near eighty percent, are roughly eighty percent correct over time? Eight successes out of ten below illustrate the idea. They are not measured Jev results, and every group of ten need not contain exactly eight successes. A training objective is one thing; checking that it holds on your tasks is another.
transition: 那么，普通 LLM 直接返回同样的 JSON，不也可以吗？
Could an ordinary LLM simply return the same JSON?

label: 换一封未参与训练的新邮件
Try an email not used in training
end: 新邮件预测 billing 0.80，答案暂不揭晓
The new email receives billing at 0.80; its answer is hidden

label: 为什么考虑 Jev，而不只用 LLM JSON
labelEn: Why consider Jev instead of LLM JSON?
action: 先给双方相同的 JSON，再对照格式约束与训练目标
actionEn: Show identical JSON, then compare format constraints with training objectives
look: 两边收到同一封邮件、返回相同的教学 JSON。合法格式本身不能证明概率校准。
Both models receive the same email and show identical illustrative JSON. A valid format alone does not establish calibrated probabilities.
say: 可以。这里故意让两边返回一模一样的 JSON，连数字都一样；它们是教学数值，没有现场调用模型。给 LLM 加 JSON Schema，完全可以解决字段和格式问题。但写出 0.61，不等于这个概率已经校准。Jev 的区别是专门面向这类有限判断和概率来训练、提供输出。普通 LLM 也能做额外训练或校准；Jev 也必须实测。选择它的理由不能只是“会返回 JSON”。

Yes. Both sides deliberately show identical JSON, including the numbers. These are teaching values, with no live model calls. JSON Schema can constrain an LLM’s fields and format, but writing 0.61 does not establish calibration. Jev’s distinction is specialized training and outputs for bounded decisions and probabilities. Ordinary LLMs can also receive additional training or calibration, and Jev still requires evaluation. Returning JSON alone is not a reason to choose it.

label: 双方都可以返回合法 JSON
Both can return valid JSON
end: 同样的合法 JSON，继续看训练和概率质量
Identical valid JSON; examine training and probability quality

label: 重复工单中，什么时候值得考虑 Jev
labelEn: When repeated routing makes Jev worth considering
action: 连续处理三封邮件，让概率进入同一条代码规则
actionEn: Process three tickets with probabilities and the same code rule
look: 三个工单分别进入退货、账单和人工复核。双方都能驱动这条流程；下面比较适用任务与评估指标。
Three tickets go to returns, billing and human review. Either model can drive the workflow; the bottom compares workload fit and evaluation criteria.
say: 把工作放大到每天反复分流工单：问的总是“交给哪个部门”，代码真正需要的是选项和可用的概率。这里按教学规则，概率达到 0.80 才直接分流，混合诉求交给人复核；用普通 LLM 也能实现。考虑 Jev，是因为这项工作不需要自由续写，而它把训练和输出集中在判断上，值得检查是否能在同样质量下减少延迟和成本。偶尔分类，或本来就需要一封完整回复，LLM JSON 可能已经够用。最终拿同一批新工单比较判断错误、校准、延迟和成本；演示不替我们宣布谁赢。

Scale this to routing tickets repeatedly every day. The question stays the same: which team? Code needs a choice and usable probabilities. Under our illustrative rule, a top probability of at least 0.80 routes directly; the mixed request goes to human review. An ordinary LLM can do this too. Jev is worth considering because this job does not need free-form generation, and its training and outputs focus on decisions: test whether that reduces latency or cost at the same required quality. For occasional classification, or a workflow already needing a complete written reply, LLM JSON may suffice. Compare errors, calibration, latency and cost on the same new tickets; this demonstration does not declare a winner.
transition: 再看 AI 能否帮助改进下一代 AI。
Now, can AI help improve the next AI?

label: 把重复判断接入分流规则
Connect repeated decisions to a routing rule
end: 三封邮件完成分流，再比较是否值得换模型
Three tickets are routed; compare whether changing models is worthwhile

label: RSI 是什么
action: 停在术语开场页
actionEn: Hold the chapter opening
look: RSI、Recursive Self-Improvement 和下一代 AI 的问题独占一页。
RSI, Recursive Self-Improvement and the successor question fill a dedicated page.
say: RSI 是 Recursive Self-Improvement，递归自我改进。它问的是：AI 能否帮助造出更有能力的后继，而后继又更擅长推动下一轮改进？
RSI means Recursive Self-Improvement. Can AI help build a more capable successor that becomes better at driving another improvement cycle?
transition: 关键在于，改进能力能不能继续传下去。
The key is whether improvement ability can carry forward.

label: 认识 RSI
Introducing RSI
end: RSI、Recursive Self-Improvement 和下一代 AI 的问题独占一页。
RSI, Recursive Self-Improvement and the successor question fill a dedicated page.
say: RSI 是 Recursive Self-Improvement，递归自我改进。它问的是：AI 能否帮助造出更有能力的后继，而后继又更擅长推动下一轮改进？
RSI means Recursive Self-Improvement. Can AI help build a more capable successor that becomes better at driving another improvement cycle?

label: 递归改进是什么意思
action: 展示后继系统与带问号的回程
actionEn: Show a successor and a questioned return path
look: A 指向后继 B，B 通往下一轮的箭头保留问号。
A points to successor B. The path from B into another cycle retains a question mark.
say: 研究常常有很多想法，缺的是实现和实验的时间，所以会让 AI 帮忙提出、实现和检查方案。图里的 A 帮助改进出 B，B 通往下一轮的箭头仍然带着问号：它是否真的更擅长研究，能不能把改进能力传下去，都需要验证。让同一个模型改写一次答案，还没有走到这个问题。

Research often has more ideas than time for implementation and experiments, motivating AI assistance with proposals, implementation and checks. Here A helps improve B, but the arrow from B into another cycle still has a question mark. Whether B is better at research, and whether that ability carries forward, must be tested. Asking the same model to revise one answer does not establish that.
transition: 用一个小实验看看，什么改进值得留下。
A small experiment will show which changes deserve to stay.

label: 改进改进的方法
Improve the method of improvement
end: A → B → C？
A → B → C?
say: 研究常常有很多想法，缺的是实现和实验的时间，所以会让 AI 帮忙提出、实现和检查方案。图里的 A 帮助改进出 B，B 通往下一轮的箭头仍然带着问号：它是否真的更擅长研究，能不能把改进能力传下去，都需要验证。让同一个模型改写一次答案，还没有走到这个问题。

Here A helps improve B, but the arrow from B into another cycle still has a question mark. Whether B is better at research, and whether that ability carries forward, must be tested. Asking the same model to revise one answer does not establish that.

label: 如何检验一次改进
action: 运行 A 基线与 B 候选，暂停在检查之前
actionEn: Run baseline A and candidate B, pausing before B’s check
look: A 已通过检查；B 已运行结束、操作较少，但尚未检查或标红，保留者仍是 A。
A has passed its checks. B has finished with fewer operations, but has not been checked or marked red. A remains retained.
say: 任务很简单：把数字从小到大排好，一个也不能丢。这些事先写好的程序会在本地真正运行，方块和计数来自实际操作。先看 A 完成任务，再换 B。B 用的操作明显少了，好像节省了不少工作。先别急着替换：结果还没有检查。你会根据操作量直接留下 B 吗？

The task is simple: put the numbers in ascending order without losing any. These prewritten programs run locally; the block movements and counts come from their actual operations. A completes the task, then B uses noticeably less work. Before replacing A, remember that B’s result has not been checked. Would the lower operation count alone persuade you to keep B?

label: 运行并检查基线 A
Run and check baseline A
end: 保留已验证的 A
Keep verified A
say: 任务很简单：把数字从小到大排好，一个也不能丢。事先写好的程序在本地真正运行，方块和计数来自实际操作。A 已排好并通过检查，下面是它用的操作量。

The task is simple: put the numbers in ascending order without losing any. These prewritten programs run locally; the movements and counts come from their actual operations. A has sorted the numbers and passed the checks. Below is the work it used.

label: 运行候选 B，暂不检查
Run B before checking
end: B 已运行完，正确性尚未检查
B has finished; correctness is unchecked
say: 再换 B。B 用的操作明显少了。先别急着替换：结果还没有检查。你会根据操作量直接留下 B 吗？
Now B uses noticeably less work. Before replacing A, remember that B’s result has not been checked. Would the lower operation count alone persuade you to keep B?

label: 先做对，再比较改进
action: 检查淘汰 B，运行并验证 C
actionEn: Reject B after checking, then run and verify C
look: B 的错误已揭晓；C 通过六项检查，在同组测试上操作更少，保留者更新为 C。
B’s errors are revealed. C passes all six checks, uses less work on the same suite and becomes the retained method.
say: 一检查，B 的顺序还不对。少做了操作，却没有完成任务，所以淘汰。接着运行 C：它通过六项检查，在同一组测试里也比 A 用更少的操作，这才值得替换。留下的是一个下次还能使用的程序。六项测试支持的是这组结果，不能证明所有输入都正确。这里最重要的是提出候选之后，必须有独立检查。

The check reveals that B’s output is still out of order. It did less work without completing the task, so it is rejected. C then passes all six checks and uses less work than A on the same suite, earning its place as the retained program. That program can be reused on later tasks. Six tests support these results, not correctness for every possible input. A proposal needs an independent check.
transition: 真实研究中的 AlphaEvolve 也使用这条思路。
AlphaEvolve uses this approach in real research.

label: 检查并拒绝 B

end: B 没有通过正确性检查
B fails the correctness check

label: 运行并检查 C
Run and check C
end: 保留通过测试且操作更少的 C
Keep C after it passes with less work

C then passes all six checks and uses less work than A on the same suite, earning its place as the retained program. That program can be reused on later tasks. Six tests support these results, not correctness for every possible input. A proposal needs an independent check.

label: AI 如何改进训练 AI 的工具
action: 沿着 Gemini、kernel、Gemini 训练展示同一段代码的去向
actionEn: Follow the kernel from Gemini’s proposal into Gemini training
look: 改进后的 K 移入 Train Gemini；下方保留局部提速与整体训练节省，主线是 AI 帮助改进训练 AI 的工具。
The improved K moves into Train Gemini. The reported figures support the main relationship: AI helps improve the tools used to train AI.
say: 看这段代码从哪里来，又到哪里去。AlphaEvolve 用 Gemini 提出代码改法，再检查结果是否正确、运行是否更快。Kernel 就是训练时反复调用的一小段计算程序。通过检查的改进，又进入 Gemini 的训练过程。DeepMind 报告，这个矩阵计算 kernel 提速 23%，让整体训练时间减少约 1%。这两个数是局部和整体的结果证据；这一页的重点是，AI 已经能帮助改进用来训练 AI 的工具。

Follow where this code comes from and where it goes. AlphaEvolve uses Gemini to propose code changes, then checks correctness and speed. label: 检验 B，再让它参与下一轮改进

say: 怎样检查？继续用同一种工作：换一段没有参与刚才开发的 kernel，给 A 和 B 相同的任务与尝试预算。看谁能找到结果正确、提速有用的改法。这里测的是 B 能否更好地参与下一次改进，而不只是上次训练省了多少时间。假如 B 确实更擅长这项工作，就让它接过原来 A 的位置，提出下一项 kernel 改进，再帮助开发 C。C 也要重新检验。Recursive，递归，强调的就是这种反馈：上一轮得到的更有能力的 AI，又参与推动下一轮改进。图里的后半段是需要验证的路径；Google 的那项 kernel 成果本身，还没有证明这个循环成立。

How would we test that? Keep the type of work the same: use new kernels excluded from the earlier development, and give A and B the same tasks and experiment budget. Compare their ability to find correct changes with useful speedups. This tests whether B can contribute more to the next improvement, beyond the time saved in its own training. If B is better at this work, it can take the role A held, propose the next kernel improvement, and help develop C. C must be evaluated again. Recursive describes this feedback: the more capable AI produced by one round contributes to the next round of improvement. The latter part of this diagram is a path to test; Google’s reported kernel result alone does not establish the cycle.

Computer Use lets AI act through interfaces; we check whether the application reached the goal. Jev targets defined decisions; we check reliability and suitability in the real workflow. RSI concerns improvement ability passing to a successor and continuing the cycle, which requires independent evidence at each round. For a new AI term, follow the same questions: what does it do, where does its capability come from, and how do we check the result?
